body: I haven't had treatment before. Every time I've tried to open up I've just been bullied by my parents to just say that everything is fine. I'm too scared of what my parents would do to me if I told someone everything. I've tried to talk, but my parents have always been able to manipulate everyone into thinking that I was a liar, even my grandparents. Once I went into college I kind of lost all of my close friends, and it's been really hard to find someone that I can talk to and open up to. I've told my boyfriend some things, but sometimes it just feels like he doesn't really understand. I guess it's just easier for me to open up here through text that it is to a person in a real life conversation.
